description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Execute authentication challenges using supported factor types. Callers initiate a session and step through one or more challenges — password, OTP, passkey, or a federated identity provider — until authentication succeeds or fails.

These endpoints are secure by default: they are gated by a server-level secret (`server.security.direct_auth_secret`). While no secret is configured they are blocked with `401`. Once configured, every request must include that value in the `Direct-Auth-Secret` header (see the `DirectAuthSecret` security scheme); requests with a missing or incorrect value are rejected with `401`.
